title: 3-4. GOD APPEARED TO ME AT LUZ

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Jacob said to Joseph, 'God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and there he blessed me and said to me, "I am going to make you fruitful and increase your numbers. I will make you a community of peoples, and I will give this land as an everlasting possession to your descendants after you."'" — Gen 48:3-4 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Jacob begins with a memory. Luz — the place he later called Bethel — where he had run away with nothing, slept on a stone, and God met him anyway (Gen 28). That was decades ago. Everything since has been shaped by that night.

Notice what an old man talks about at the end of his life. Not his achievements. Not his wealth or his sons' success. He talks about the time God met him and spoke.

This is a specific covenant promise, made to Jacob about the land of Canaan and his physical descendants. We should not lift it out and apply it directly to ourselves; that promise had a particular recipient and a particular fulfilment in Israel's history. But what we can take is the pattern of Jacob's memory, and the character of the God who made the promise. He speaks, and He keeps His word across generations.

Every believer needs some Luz — a moment, a season, a night when God became real to you and not just an idea. Not because feelings are the foundation of faith, but because remembering God's dealings with you steadies you when everything else shakes.

Tell someone about your Luz. It may be the most useful thing you ever say to them.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. What is your "Luz" — a time God became real to you?
2. When did you last tell someone about it?
3. What do you find yourself talking about most: what God has done, or what you have done?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You for the times You have made Yourself real to me. Help me remember them clearly and speak of them freely, so that others may know You are a God who keeps His word. Amen.
